items.title: Can Traveling With Your Dog Make Every Journey More Meaningful?
items.snippet: From photographing dogs worldwide to traveling with his beloved Elsa, The Dogist founder Elias Weiss Friedman shares how canine companionship transformed his career, inspired a business and enriched his travels.

items.title: Japan Is Closing in on the U.S. as High Costs and Politics Deter Travelers, Brand USA Says
items.snippet: Skift Take: Research shows the U.S. losing ground to Japan as costs and politics turn travelers away. Brand USA is betting the lost demand is deferred, not gone, but its budget to win it back is shrinking. The U.S.’ place as international travelers’ top destination is slipping as more key markets look to Japan and other destinations, according to new research from Brand USA shared at its board meeting Tuesday.

items.title: Mercure Hyderabad KCP Welcomes Amzala Chaitanya as Director of Sales
items.snippet: Bringing over 13 years of extensive experience in the hospitality industry to the hotel’s commercial leadership team. In his new role, Chaitanya will spearhead the hotel’s overall sales and marketing strategy, driving business growth across key segments including Rooms, Corporate Sales, Banquets, MICE and Business Development.

items.title: Tivoli Hospitality Group Doubles Down on Chhatarpur with launch of Midori by Tivoli
items.snippet: New luxury property to feature expansive banqueting venues, premium rooms and leisure facilities, targeting the growing weddings, celebrations and MICE market in Delhi-NCR. Following the successful establishment of its premium five-star property, The Tivoli Hotel, in Chhatarpur, Tivoli Hospitality Group is all geared up to launch Midori by Tivoli on November 13, 2026.

items.title: FLY91 to launch daily Navi Mumbai Sindhudurg flights
items.snippet: FLY91 will launch daily flights connecting Sindhudurg with Navi Mumbai from November 16, restoring a direct air link between the district in South Maharashtra and the Mumbai region.

items.title: Accor, Hard Rock enter partnership on loyalty, distribution
items.snippet: The agreement will expand Hard Rock’s distribution network and accelerate its global development, while enhancing both companies’ loyalty programs. The agreement, which aims to preserve Hard Rock’s “distinctive identity and guest experience,” is expected to close by the end of this year, a Hard Rock International representative told Hotel Dive.

items.title: IRCTC intensifies action against unauthorised e-catering platforms
items.snippet: The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) has launched a stringent enforcement drive to identify and curb unauthorised e-catering websites and mobile applications operating across the Indian Railways network. The initiative aims to protect passengers from risks associated with food safety, hygiene, data privacy and financial security arising from the use of unverified food-ordering platforms.

items.title: Grevon and Indio Partner to Enable End-to-End AI Bookings for RV Parks and Campgrounds
items.snippet: Grevon and Indio are integrating to let RV park and campground guests inquire, check availability, and pay within a single AI conversation, without redirection to a separate booking engine.

items.title: Accor signs Novotel Jim Corbett Chhoi, marking Uttarakhand debut in 2029
items.snippet: Accor has announced the signing of Novotel Jim Corbett Chhoi, marking the hospitality group’s entry into Uttarakhand. Scheduled to open in 2029, the 150-key property will strengthen Accor’s presence in India’s leisure hospitality market, particularly in wildlife and nature-based destinations.

items.title: Fairmont Hotels and Resorts opens 100th hotel globally with debut of Fairmont New Orleans
items.snippet: Fairmont Hotels and Resorts, part of Accor, has officially opened Fairmont New Orleans, marking the luxury hospitality brand’s 100th hotel worldwide and its return to the Louisiana city after two decades.
